risk_note: RV2 migration (agent lane B3-08e; D10-194 C). New app.agent_rule_chunks (0099): chunks of published help / rule articles, 10 columns, no vector column and no new extension; chunk_id uuid primary key without default; composite foreign key (article_id, published_version) → app.articles(id, version), NO ACTION; UNIQUE (article_id, published_version, seq); CHECKs on version / seq / non-empty title and text / char_length(text) ≤ 200 / status ∈ {active, retired} and (status='retired') = (retired_at IS NOT NULL); index (app_id, status). Guard trigger: only active → retired with retired_at in the same statement (same-value writes on retired rows pass), everything else 23001. Grants: couli_app SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE(status, retired_at); couli_readonly reads the non-text columns; no DELETE / TRUNCATE / REFERENCES / TRIGGER; payout and maint have none. db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts from the test machine's db:snapshot. No amounts, ledger, settlement or payout state. Counter correction D10-225 (accepted by the orchestrator): the first two dispatches never started Codex (node-modules-missing, then brief-failed over 24KB) and left no output, so attempts.test was set back to 0 (couli-runs/B3-08e/evidence-note-D10-225.md). Reviews were not re-run: the migration text is unchanged. D10-386 (orchestrator 2026-10-27 17:4x): the table is named app.agent_rule_chunks (derived constraint / index / trigger names alike) so that agent's writes stay inside the agent_* tables of the write-scope gate (CT-06zu, BR-AI-02); 04 §3.2 is updated by the orchestrator.
